dyadic block Sidon construction fails hidden-subsequence attack: explicit witness N=2^(2k+3)-1 in inter-block gap gives |A∩[1,N]|/sqrt(N)≈sqrt(E_k/N)->0 along infinitely many N, violating "for all sufficiently large N"; naive repair (cross-scale Sidon superposition with density floor) is equivalent-

candidate log-free estimate f(n)=Theta(sqrt(n)) refuted: Shearer f(n)<=C*sqrt(n/log n)=o(sqrt(n)) for all large n while AKS/Kim give lower side Theta(sqrt(n/log n)); true order is Theta(sqrt(n/log n)), so universal c*sqrt(n) lower bound fails (adapted from erdos503 R005/L1 side-only refutation); exa

dilation lemma refuted at minimal parameters B={1}, C=odds (2b=2 even, B+B⊄C); counterexample is exact, load-bearing for R007/R008 doubles coverage, and does not refute the canonical target, which remains open — R008 has no surviving close with L3 deleted

Zero-step degenerate walk (S∋0, constant walk, singleton A) satisfies all stated premises and violates the conclusion; statement needs 0∉S and infinitely many distinct points before the real conjecture is engaged.

REFUTED by external audit (GPT gold-mine audit + R4, 2026-09-01), each item re-verified by the operator's session against the frozen contract or by exact computation on 2026-09-02 | FALSE: Pintz/Rankin-type results concern LARGE GAPS between consecutive primes, not the length of arithmetic progressions of primes in [1,N]. No theorem gives L(N) = omega(log N) infinitely often; the longest known prime APs in [1,N] have length far below log N and the o(log N) question is open. 'negative close achieved' is a citation misuse.
